note: V1.22: re-tuned by tools/tune_weights_1m.py after (a) the positioning signals' cross-sectional rank was made SIZE-NEUTRAL (lib/signals/percentiles.size_neutral_rank) and (b) the tuner gained a significance gate (--min-t 1.0, --min-n 20) on top of the existing correct-sign requirement. TWO CHANGES OF SUBSTANCE. First, insider_net_90d_signed goes 0.1139 -> 0.0. Its IC was almost entirely the market-cap tilt in the old universe rank: raw pct_peer was -0.24 to -0.39 rank-correlated with log mcap across 2024-2026, all of its IC sat in pct_peer (1m -0.024) and none in the size-neutral pct_self (-0.007), and once the peer rank was neutralized its IC fell to -0.0036 (t -0.51). The signal was reading 'big company whose insiders sold a lot of dollars', which is why CRWD's $203m of 90d net insider selling was pushing it toward 'under-owned'. Second, the gate also drops ret_6m (t -0.25) and dist_200ma (t -0.45) from technical - a side effect of the gate, not of size-neutralization, and a separate finding from the positioning work. The three surviving positioning signals all strengthened their standing: short_volume_ratio_14d t -1.80, si_true_dtc t -1.77, float_turnover_20d t -2.23. Critically, the positioning BUCKET's IC is essentially unchanged after neutralization (-0.0211, t -3.68, vs -0.022/t -3.8 before), so its edge was NOT merely a size premium - only the insider signal's was. OPTIONS: still untunable (n=1-2 non-overlapping 1m periods from the forward-only yfinance history); the tuner now falls back to equal weights explicitly rather than emitting a 1.0 weight off n=2. BUCKET weights unchanged at Pos 0.50 / Tech 0.20 / Opt 0.30 - the new bucket ICs (pos -0.0211, tech -0.0106) keep the ~2:1 ratio the existing split was set to.
